# Aquent Australia

> > Aquent Australia is an award-winning global recruitment and work solutions agency specializing in permanent, contract, and freelance talent for marketing, design, and technology roles.

Aquent Australia provides comprehensive talent acquisition services, creative co-creation capabilities, and specialized consulting across sustainability and digital accessibility. The platform serves both employers seeking specialized talent and professionals in marketing, design, and technology seeking career opportunities and professional development.

## Core Recruitment Services

- [Aquent Australia: Marketing, Design & Technology Recruitment Agency](https://aquent.com.au): Aquent Australia homepage: award-winning global recruitment for marketing, design, tech talent

- [Permanent Recruitment in Marketing, Design & Technology | Aquent Australia](https://aquent.com.au/solutions/aquent-talent/permanent): Permanent recruitment service for marketing, design, and technology talent
- [Freelance and Contract Recruitment | Aquent Australia](https://aquent.com.au/solutions/aquent-talent/contract-freelance): Contract and freelance recruitment for marketing, design, and technology projects
- [Temp-to-Perm Recruitment | Aquent Australia](https://aquent.com.au/solutions/aquent-talent/temp-to-perm): Temp-to-perm service: assess talent performance over 90 days before permanent hire
